ui.ctaTitle: Tired of reprinting every time the day changes?
ui.ctaBody: Make a living schedule in My Starday — your child sees what’s now and what’s next, without a new print-out.
ui.teacchDisclaimer: TEACCH-inspired paper materials — not the same as the app’s live schedule, and not an official TEACCH method.
ui.bildkortIntro: Cut out the cards. Laminate if you can. Use them on a board or the fridge.
ui.rewardNote: A printable star chart — the same idea as the Treasure Chamber in the app, on paper.
ui.weeklyNote: A static weekly template. In the app the week updates without reprinting.

howTo: Print on A4 and put it where your child can see the day.
Tick steps with a pen, or cut out the picture cards for a board.
Once the routine sticks, your child can follow the same steps in the app — no reprint when the day changes.

hub.title: Free visual supports to print
hub.description: Free printable visual schedules, picture cards and PDF templates for children’s daily routines. Static printables — separate from the interactive app.
hub.h1: Free resources — visual supports to print
hub.lead: Free PDFs and picture cards to print at home or in preschool. This is a static library. The My Starday app is the living version — your child ticks steps, earns stars and sees what happens next.
hub.paperVsAppBody: Paper works when you want something on the wall. The app is for families who don’t want to reprint every time the week changes.
